# Lessons

What the runs showed, the runs that show it, and what changed because of it. A finding with nothing changed yet says so.

| Finding | Runs that show it | What changed |

| Workflow pods waited for a token secret that Argo's install did not create, until the workflow's deadline. | [First workflows, attempt, investigate-2llvm](2026-10-21-1412-first-workflows-attempt.md#investigate-2llvm) | The manifests create the executor's token ([troubleshooting 14](../troubleshooting/14-workflow-pods-wait-for-the-executors-token.md)). |
